description: This file defines the XTextFormatter class, which provides a simple text formatting and drawing utility for PDFs using the PdfSharp library. It handles text layout, line breaking, and alignment within a specified rectangle.

classes.name: XTextFormatter
classes.description: A simple text formatter class for rendering paragraph text into a specified layout rectangle.

methods.name: XTextFormatter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formatter with a graphics context.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws the specified text within the layout rectangle using the given font and brush, with optional string format.

methods.name: CreateBlocks
methods.description: Splits the text into blocks of words and line breaks, preparing for layout.

methods.name: CreateLayout
methods.description: Calculates line wrapping and positioning of text blocks within the layout rectangle.

methods.name: AlignLine
methods.description: Aligns a line of text blocks for left, center, right, or justified alignment.
